variables.name: semantic/bg-neutral-fill-ghost-default
variables.description: Resting fill of ghost interactive surfaces (ghost/secondary buttons, tabs, menu items). Transparent, not white, so it composes on any surface. The ladder anchors one step below muted: transparent -> step 3 (hover) -> step 4 (active), because the jump from nothing to the muted hover step is too large.
